parts.gloss: through an easy and gentle demeanor

words.gloss: through an easy and gentle demeanor

literal: Through easy approachability, to attain is easy, they say, towards anyone, the practice called courtesy.
translation: They say that the path of courtesy is easy to attain for those who maintain an easily approachable demeanor towards everyone.
modern: யாரிடத்தும் எளிமையாகப் பழகும் தன்மையைக் கொண்டிருப்பதன் மூலம், பண்புடைமை என்று சொல்லப்படும் நல்வழியை அடைவது எளிது என்று கூறுவர்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the importance of being easily approachable to everyone, regardless of their status. The author explains that possessing a gentle, accessible demeanor is the key to mastering the virtue of courtesy or noble character. When a person is humble and easy to interact with, practicing goodness and maintaining harmonious relationships becomes natural and effortless. Thus, accessibility is presented not just as a polite trait, but as the very gateway to true nobility.
